studentPredictionScope: Explicit uncertainty before execution; not an all/some forecast or a numerical hypothesis.
sampling: Seeds base+1 onward. Check connectivity with separate text-grid BFS. Accept connected maps with at least one wall; preserve candidate seeds, distances, wall counts and rejection reasons.
wallRemoval: Blocked cells sorted row-major; remove index candidateSeed modulo blockedCount. Exactly one wall removed per accepted map. Deterministic selection, not uniform wall sampling.
priorRoute: Offline unlimited A* FIFO on each original connected map; verify its path and length against candidate BFS. Record acquisition calls/expansions separately from online policy work.
measurements: Same acquired prior route and same edited map per pair. Report usable routes, returned lengths over all 30 paired maps, planner expansions, optimization completions/budget failures, theoretical improvements from edited-map BFS, realized improvements within budget, retained fallbacks and potential missed improvements. No timing/energy measurement.
controls: Fixed endpoints (0,0) and (15,11), four-neighbor unit costs, only one wall changes to open, current position remains the original start for this batch. Not a progressed/moving robot.
attribution: Student selected reoptimization earlier and reports uncertainty here. AI proposes sampling/edit/protocol, implements/executes/validates the study and writes initial analysis. No student method/code authorship, directional prediction or independent operation inferred.
scope: Thirty accepted synthetic parent/edited pairs reused by two policies; not 60 independent maps. This new seed range alone does not establish statistical independence from earlier studies. Commit ready protocol and source before cohort execution.
